# 建议卡堆叠 (Agent Suggest Card Stack)

> AI 助手回复用的一叠建议卡,带进度条、成功与失败状态以及提交按钮。

- 分类:AI 组件
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/agent-suggest-card-stack
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/agent-suggest-card-stack
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/agent-suggest-card-stack.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/agent-suggest-card-stack
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { AgentSuggestBotBadge } from "@/components/ui/agent-suggest-card-stack"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <AgentSuggestBotBadge />
  )
}
~~~

## 导出部件

- `AgentSuggestBotBadge`
- `AgentSuggestCardFrame`
- `AgentSuggestCardStack`
- `AgentSuggestCommitButton`
- `SuggestionItem`
- `VercelLogo`

## 依赖

- 无额外依赖
---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

# 流光边框卡片 (Border Beam Card)

> 带有一道沿边缘循环流动光束的卡片组件,基于 shadcn Card 封装,常用于功能亮点展示与定价卡。

- 分类:卡片
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/border-beam-card
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/border-beam-card
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/border-beam-card.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/border-beam-card
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import {
  BorderBeamCard,
  BorderBeamCardHeader,
  BorderBeamCardTitle,
  BorderBeamCardDescription,
  BorderBeamCardContent,
} from "@/components/ui/border-beam-card"

<BorderBeamCard className="w-sm">
  <BorderBeamCardHeader>
    <BorderBeamCardTitle>流光边框</BorderBeamCardTitle>
    <BorderBeamCardDescription>一道光束沿卡片边缘循环流动。</BorderBeamCardDescription>
  </BorderBeamCardHeader>
  <BorderBeamCardContent>内容区</BorderBeamCardContent>
</BorderBeamCard>
~~~

## 导出部件

- `BorderBeamCard`
- `BorderBeamCardAction`
- `BorderBeamCardContent`
- `BorderBeamCardDescription`
- `BorderBeamCardFooter`
- `BorderBeamCardHeader`
- `BorderBeamCardTitle`

## 依赖

- 无额外依赖
## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | — | 卡片内容。 |
| `size` | `"default" \| "sm"` | `"default"` | 卡片布局密度,与 shadcn Card 的 size 一致。 |
| `beamSize` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "line"` | `"md"` | 光束粗细预设。 |
| `cardClassName` | `string` | — | 合并到内部 Card 的类名。 |
| `theme` | `"auto" \| ...` | `"auto"` | 光束配色主题,auto 跟随明暗模式。 |
| `borderRadius` | `string \| number` | — | 覆盖圆角。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

# 可展开卡片 (Expandable)

> 在收起与展开状态间平滑动画,展开后显示更多细节。

- 分类:卡片
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/expandable
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/expandable
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/expandable.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/expandable
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { Expandable } from "@/components/ui/expandable"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Expandable />
  )
}
~~~

## 导出部件

- `Expandable`
- `ExpandableCard`
- `ExpandableCardContent`
- `ExpandableCardFooter`
- `ExpandableCardHeader`
- `ExpandableContent`
- `ExpandableTrigger`
- `useExpandable`

## 依赖

- `motion`
- `react-use-measure`

## 源码属性定义

### AnimationProps

~~~ts
interface AnimationProps {
  initial?: TargetAndTransition
  animate?: TargetAndTransition
  exit?: TargetAndTransition
  transition?: any
}
~~~

### ExpandableCardProps

~~~ts
interface ExpandableCardProps {
  children: ReactNode
  className?: string
  collapsedSize?: { width?: number; height?: number } // Size when collapsed
  expandedSize?: { width?: number; height?: number } // Size when expanded
  hoverToExpand?: boolean // Whether to expand on hover
  expandDelay?: number // Delay before expanding
  collapseDelay?: number // Delay before collapsing
}
~~~

# 折角卡片 (Folded Card)

> 可组合的折角卡片组件,右上角带真实翻折效果,适合模板集市、博客索引、资源目录等场景。

- 分类:卡片
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/folded-card
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/folded-card
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/folded-card.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/folded-card
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import {
  FoldedCard, FoldedCardFold, FoldedCardLink, FoldedCardBorder,
  FoldedCardPreview, FoldedCardGrid, FoldedCardFooter,
  FoldedCardHeading, FoldedCardTitle, FoldedCardBadge,
  FoldedCardDescription,
} from "@/components/ui/folded-card"

<FoldedCard>
  <FoldedCardFold />
  <FoldedCardLink href="/docs/components/folded-card">
    <FoldedCardBorder />
    <FoldedCardPreview>
      <FoldedCardGrid />
    </FoldedCardPreview>
    <FoldedCardFooter>
      <FoldedCardHeading>
        <FoldedCardTitle>折角卡片</FoldedCardTitle>
        <FoldedCardBadge>新</FoldedCardBadge>
      </FoldedCardHeading>
      <FoldedCardDescription>右上角带折角的卡片。</FoldedCardDescription>
    </FoldedCardFooter>
  </FoldedCardLink>
</FoldedCard>
~~~

## 导出部件

- `ChatTail`
- `FoldedCard`
- `FoldedCardBadge`
- `FoldedCardBorder`
- `FoldedCardDescription`
- `FoldedCardFold`
- `FoldedCardFooter`
- `FoldedCardGrid`
- `FoldedCardHeading`
- `FoldedCardLink`
- `FoldedCardPreview`
- `FoldedCardTitle`

## 依赖

- 无额外依赖
## 备注

原组件基于 Next.js Link,本站已将其适配为标准 <a> 标签,可在 Vite 中直接使用。

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FoldedCard` | `div props` | — | 根容器,默认 max-w-sm 并应用折角裁剪路径。 |
| `FoldedCardFold` | `div props` | — | 右上角 40×40px 的翻折角。 |
| `FoldedCardLink` | `a props` | — | 链接包装器(Vite 环境渲染为 <a>)。 |
| `FoldedCardPreview` | `div props` | — | 预览区,默认高 228px。 |
| `FoldedCardGrid` | `rows?, columns?` | — | 装饰网格,默认 4×4。 |
| `FoldedCardTitle` | `h3 props` | — | 卡片标题。 |
| `FoldedCardBadge` | `span props` | — | 小徽章。 |
| `FoldedCardDescription` | `p props` | — | 描述,默认 line-clamp-3。 |

# Halo 拖放上传 (Halo Dropzone)

> 带动画虚线边框与文件类型图标的拖放上传区,支持键盘操作。

- 分类:表单与输入
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/halo-dropzone
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/halo-dropzone
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/halo-dropzone.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/halo-dropzone
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx

export function Example() {
  return (
    <DropzoneFileTypeGlyph />
  )
}
~~~

## 导出部件

- `DropzoneFileTypeGlyph`
- `DropzoneUploadFileList`
- `DropzoneUploadFileRow`
- `FilePlaceholderKind`
- `FileTypePlaceholder`
- `HaloDropzone`
- `QueuedFile`
- `fileKey`
- `formatFileBytes`
- `inferPlaceholderKind`

## 依赖

- `lucide-react`
- `motion`

## 源码属性定义

### DropzoneBodyProps

~~~ts
interface DropzoneBodyProps {
  cf: ReturnType<typeof crossfade>
  cfTransition: ReturnType<typeof crossfadeTransition>
  disabled: boolean
  emptyLabel: string
  formatHint: string | null
  idleIcon?: ReactNode
  imageObjectUrls: Record<string, string>
  reduceMotion: boolean
  showSuccess: boolean
  showSuccessThumbnails: boolean
  successLabel: string
  uploadedFiles: File[]
}
~~~

### HaloDropzoneProps

~~~ts
export interface HaloDropzoneProps {
  className?: string
  accept?: string
  multiple?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  /** Frosted glass fill (matches composer translucent mode). */
  translucent?: boolean
  /** Called after files are chosen via drop or picker. */
  onFiles?: (files: File[]) => void
  /**
   * Clear the success state after this many ms. `0` keeps success until the next
   * drop or until the user picks again.
   */
  successResetMs?: number
  /** Primary line in the idle slot. */
  emptyLabel?: string
  /** Line under the filename in the success slot. */
  successLabel?: string
  /** Optional icon override for the idle slot (defaults to upload). */
  idleIcon?: ReactNode
  /** Secondary line under the title; set `null` to hide. */
  formatHint?: string | null
  /**
   * When the dropzone shows success, render thumbnail previews inside the zone.
   * Set `false` if you show file details (e.g. upload rows) below the dropzone.
   */
  showSuccessThumbnails?: boolean
}
~~~

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

## 导出部件

- `HaloToggleGroup`
- `HaloToggleGroupItem`

## 依赖

- `@base-ui/react`
- `motion`

## 源码属性定义

### HaloToggleGroupProps

~~~ts
export interface HaloToggleGroupProps {
  items: HaloToggleGroupItem[]
  /** Selected value; omit for uncontrolled usage with `defaultValue`. */
  value?: string
  defaultValue?: string
  onValueChange?: (next: string) => void
  className?: string
  /** Frosted track + backdrop blur (matches card/button translucent mode). */
  translucent?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
}
~~~

~~~ts
interface OgImageSectionProps {
  tabs: Tab[]
  className?: string
  /** Outer container radius (e.g. `rounded-lg`) */

}
~~~

# 程序坞 (Dock)

> macOS 风格的底部程序坞,鼠标靠近时图标放大、点击弹出动效,适合作品集与工具栏场景。

- 分类:导航与标签页
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/dock
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/dock
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/dock.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/dock
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { Dock, DockCard, DockCardInner, DockDivider } from "@/components/ui/dock"

<Dock className="fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2">
  <DockCard id="1">
    <DockCardInner src="/icons/figma.svg" id="1" />
  </DockCard>
  <DockDivider />
</Dock>
~~~

## 导出部件

- `Dock`
- `DockCard`
- `DockCardInner`
- `DockDivider`
- `useDock`
- `useMousePosition`

## 依赖

- `motion`

## 源码属性定义

### DockProps

~~~ts
interface DockProps {
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode // React children to be rendered within the dock
}
~~~

### DockCardInnerProps

~~~ts
interface DockCardInnerProps {
  src: string // Source URL for the image
  id: string // Unique identifier for the card
  children?: ReactNode // Optional children for the card
}
~~~

## 备注

图标通过 DockCardInner 的 src 传入,任意图片皆可。

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Dock` | `className, children` | — | 根容器,管理悬停与缩放状态。 |
| `DockCard` | `children, id` | — | 单个图标卡,点击触发布局动画。 |
| `DockCardInner` | `src, id, children` | — | 图标图片(必须有 src)。 |
| `DockDivider` | `—` | — | 分隔线。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。


~~~tsx

    <HaloPolishedNotification />
  )
}
~~~

## 导出部件

- `HaloPolishedNotification`

## 依赖

- `@base-ui/react`
- `lucide-react`
- `motion`

## 源码属性定义

### HaloPolishedToastSurfaceProps

~~~ts
export interface HaloPolishedToastSurfaceProps {
  title: string
  description?: string
  /**
   * Change when the notification shows a new message so title/body stagger replay.
   * Defaults to `title` + `description` (stable for identical copy).
   */
  messageKey?: string
  /** `status` for non-urgent updates; `alert` for urgent/interruptive content. */
  politeness?: "status" | "alert"
  onDismiss?: () => void
  /** Forwarded to the local `HaloCard`. */
  translucent?: boolean
  /** Rim blob + border-trail palette (success / error vs default). */
  rimVariant?: RimVariant
  className?: string
}
~~~

~~~ts
export interface PolishedToastSurfaceProps {

  messageKey?: string

  translucent?: boolean
  rimVariant?: RimVariant
  /** Sonner toast id from `toast.custom((id) => …)`; required for the dismiss control. */

}
~~~

# 文字动画 (Text Animate)

> 动画文字组件,提供 8 种入场效果(fadeIn、rollIn、whipIn 等),支持逐词/逐字符交错动画,适合标题与口号。

- 分类:文字与排版
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/text-animate
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/text-animate
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/text-animate.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/text-animate
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import TextAnimate from "@/components/ui/text-animate"

<TextAnimate text="让界面动起来" type="rollIn" />
~~~

## 导出部件

- `TextAnimate`

## 依赖

- `motion`
## 备注

中文没有空格分隔,组件会按字符逐个交错动画,效果同样自然。

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | — | 要展示的文字内容。 |
| `type` | `"fadeIn" \| "fadeInUp" \| "popIn" \| "shiftInUp" \| "rollIn" \| "whipIn" \| "whipInUp" \| "calmInUp"` | — | 入场动画类型。 |
| `delay` | `number` | — | 动画延迟(秒)。 |
| `duration` | `number` | — | 动画时长(秒)。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

> 带性能优化与响应式处理的分形点阵动画背景。

- 分类:背景与纹理
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/bg-animated-fractal-dot-grid
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/bg-animated-fractal-dot-grid
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/bg-animated-fractal-dot-grid.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/bg-animated-fractal-dot-grid
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx

  return (
    <FractalDotGrid />
  )
}
~~~

## 导出部件

- `FractalDotGrid`

## 依赖

- `motion`

## 源码属性定义

### FractalDotGridProps

~~~ts
interface FractalDotGridProps {
  /** Size of each dot in pixels */
  dotSize?: number
  /** Spacing between dots in pixels */
  dotSpacing?: number
  /** Opacity of dots (0-1) */
  dotOpacity?: number
  /** Intensity of the wave effect when hovering */
  waveIntensity?: number
  /** Radius of the wave effect in pixels */
  waveRadius?: number
  /** Color of the dots (supports any valid CSS color) */
  dotColor?: string
  /** Color of the dot glow effect (supports any valid CSS color) */
  glowColor?: string
  /** Enable or disable the noise overlay */
  enableNoise?: boolean
  /** Opacity of the noise overlay (0-1) */
  noiseOpacity?: number
  /** Enable or disable the mouse glow effect */
  enableMouseGlow?: boolean
  /** Set the initial performance level */
  initialPerformance?: "low" | "medium" | "high"
}
~~~

### CanvasFractalGridProps

~~~ts
interface CanvasFractalGridProps {
  /** Size of each dot in pixels */
  dotSize?: number
  /** Spacing between dots in pixels */
  dotSpacing?: number
  /** Opacity of dots (0-1) */
  dotOpacity?: number
  /** Duration of the background gradient animation in seconds */
  gradientAnimationDuration?: number
  /** Stiffness of mouse tracking (higher values make it more responsive) */
  mouseTrackingStiffness?: number
  /** Damping of mouse tracking (higher values make it less bouncy) */
  mouseTrackingDamping?: number
  /** Intensity of the wave effect when hovering */
  waveIntensity?: number
  /** Radius of the wave effect in pixels */
  waveRadius?: number
  /** Array of gradient configurations for the background */
  gradients?: GradientType[]
  /** Color of the dots (supports any valid CSS color) */
  dotColor?: string
  /** Color of the dot glow effect (supports any valid CSS color) */
  glowColor?: string
  /** Enable or disable the noise overlay */
  enableNoise?: boolean
  /** Opacity of the noise overlay (0-1) */
  noiseOpacity?: number
  /** Enable or disable the mouse glow effect */
  // …
~~~

- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/apple-iphone-17-pro
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/apple-iphone-17-pro.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/apple-iphone-17-pro
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx

export function Example() {
  return (
    <DynamicIslandSize />
  )
}
~~~

## 导出部件

- `DynamicIslandSize`
- `IPhone17ProMax`

## 依赖

- `lucide-react`
- `motion`

## 源码属性定义

### IPhoneProps

~~~ts
export interface IPhoneProps {
  /** Content to display on the screen */
  children?: ReactNode
  /** Dynamic Island size preset */
  dynamicIslandSize?: DynamicIslandSize
  /** Content to display inside the Dynamic Island when expanded */
  dynamicIslandContent?: ReactNode
  /** Frame color variant */
  frameColor?: "graphite" | "silver" | "gold" | "blue"
  /** Show status bar */
  showStatusBar?: boolean
  /** Show home indicator */
  showHomeIndicator?: boolean
  /** Custom time to display */
  time?: string
  /** Battery level (0-100) */
  batteryLevel?: number
  /** Signal strength (0-4) */
  signalStrength?: number
  /** Callback when Dynamic Island is tapped */
  onDynamicIslandTap?: () => void
  /** Callback when screen is tapped */
  onScreenTap?: () => void
  /** Custom className for the container */
  className?: string
}
~~~

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

# Mac 屏幕 (Mac Screen)

> 经典 Macintosh CRT 显示器样机,在复古屏幕框内展示图片或 GIF,响应式且零外部依赖。

- 分类:样机
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/mac-screen
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/mac-screen
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/mac-screen.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/mac-screen
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { MacScreen } from "@/components/ui/mac-screen"

<MacScreen
  gifUrl="https://example.com/preview.png"
  alt="产品截图"
/>
~~~

## 导出部件

- `MacScreen`

## 依赖

- 无额外依赖

## 源码属性定义

### MacScreenProps

~~~ts
interface MacScreenProps {
  gifUrl?: string
  alt?: string
}
~~~

## 备注

屏幕框图片位于 public/component-frames/apple-computer-img.png,本站已随项目提供。

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gifUrl` | `string` | `Giphy 默认图` | 屏幕内展示的图片或 GIF 地址。 |
| `alt` | `string` | `"Screen content"` | 图片替代文本。 |

~~~ts
interface LoadingCarouselProps {
  tips?: Tip[]
  className?: string
  autoplayInterval?: number

  showIndicators?: boolean
  showProgress?: boolean

  textPosition?: "top" | "bottom"

  backgroundTips?: boolean
  backgroundGradient?: boolean
~~~

# 分析图表 (Analytics Chart)

> Vercel 风格的 SVG 折线图组件,渐变描边、悬浮 tooltip 卡片,纯 SVG 实现无第三方图表库,适合分析仪表盘。

- 分类:数据展示
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/analytics-chart
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/analytics-chart
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/analytics-chart.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/analytics-chart
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { AnalyticsLineChart } from "@/components/ui/analytics-chart"

<AnalyticsLineChart
  data={[
    { date: "2024-01-07", label: "organic", value: 340 },
    { date: "2024-01-14", label: "organic", value: 520 },
  ]}
  valueLabel="注册量"
/>
~~~

## 导出部件

- `AnalyticsDataPoint`
- `AnalyticsGradientStop`
- `AnalyticsLineChart`
- `AnalyticsTooltip`
- `AnalyticsTooltipPoint`
- `DEFAULT_DATA`
- `DEFAULT_GRADIENT`
- `EASE_OUT`
- `PALETTE`
- `dotColor`
- `fmtDate`
- `fmtNum`

## 依赖

- 无额外依赖

## 源码属性定义

### AnalyticsTooltipProps

~~~ts
export interface AnalyticsTooltipProps {
  point: AnalyticsTooltipPoint
  color: string
  px: number
  py: number
  side: "top" | "bottom"
  valueLabel: string
  show: boolean
  /** When true, stacks above pinned/static tooltip cards */
  isHovered?: boolean
}
~~~

### AnalyticsLineChartProps

~~~ts
export interface AnalyticsLineChartProps {
  data?: AnalyticsDataPoint[]
  gradientStops?: AnalyticsGradientStop[]
  dotColors?: string[]
  gridLines?: number
  height?: number
  pinnedIndices?: number[]
  valueLabel?: string
  className?: string
}
~~~

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `AnalyticsDataPoint[]` | — | 数据点数组 {date, label, value}。 |
| `gradientStops` | `AnalyticsGradientStop[]` | — | 渐变描边的色标。 |
| `dotColors` | `string[]` | — | 按索引覆盖数据点颜色。 |
| `gridLines` | `number` | `5` | 网格线数量。 |
| `height` | `number` | `280` | viewBox 高度。 |
| `pinnedIndices` | `number[]` | — | 常显 tooltip 的索引,默认最后两个点。 |
| `valueLabel` | `string` | `"clicks"` | tooltip 中数值的标签。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

---

# 看板 (Kanban Board)

> 拖拽看板组件,卡片可在列之间拖动,支持标签、负责人头像与 Motion 布局动画,使用原生 HTML 拖放 API。

- 分类:交互
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/kanban-board
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/kanban-board
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/kanban-board.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/kanban-board
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { Column, gentleSpring } from "@/components/ui/kanban-board"
import { MotionConfig } from "motion/react"

<MotionConfig transition={gentleSpring}>
  {columns.map((col) => (
    <Column
      key={col.id}
      column={col}
      dragState={dragState}
      setDragState={setDragState}
      onDrop={(cardId, from, to) => moveCard(cardId, from, to)}
    />
  ))}
</MotionConfig>
~~~

## 导出部件

- `Assignee`
- `CardData`
- `CardTag`
- `Column`
- `ColumnData`
- `ColumnStatus`
- `DragState`
- `TagVariant`
- `gentleSpring`

## 依赖

- `motion`

## 源码属性定义

### TagProps

~~~ts
type TagProps = {
  label: string
  variant: TagVariant
}
~~~

### AvatarProps

~~~ts
type AvatarProps = {
  src?: string
  name?: string
}
~~~

## 备注

CardData 支持 { id, title, tags?, assignee?, date? };标签变体有 feature / bug / design / improvement / docs / done 六种配色。原组件的 next/image 头像已适配为标准 <img>。

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `column` | `ColumnData` | — | 列数据 {id, title, status, cards}。 |
| `onDrop` | `(cardId, fromColumnId, toColumnId) => void` | — | 卡片落下的回调,在此更新状态。 |
| `dragState` | `DragState \| null` | — | 当前拖拽中的卡片与来源列。 |
| `setDragState` | `React.Dispatch<SetStateAction<DragState>>` | — | 拖拽状态更新器。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

# 可扩展向导 (Wizard Expandable)

> 可展开的多步向导,支持前进校验、可滚动步骤轨与高度过渡。

- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/wizard-expandable
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/wizard-expandable
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/wizard-expandable.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/wizard-expandable
~~~

~~~tsx

  return (
    <WizardStep />
  )
}
~~~

## 导出部件

- `WizardStep`
- `useWizardExpandable`

## 依赖

- `@base-ui/react`
- `@radix-ui/react-use-controllable-state`
- `motion`

## 源码属性定义

### WizardExpandableProps

~~~ts
export interface WizardExpandableProps {
  steps: WizardStep[]
  badgeText?: string

  className?: string
  expanded?: boolean
  onExpandedChange?: (expanded: boolean) => void
  activeStep?: string | null
  onActiveStepChange?: (stepId: string | null) => void

  /**
   * Return false to block moving from the current step to `toStepId`.
   * Not called when opening the first step (`fromStepId` is null), closing the wizard,
   * or when `skipValidationForBackward` is true and the target step is before the current one.
   */
  canNavigateToStep?: (context: WizardNavigateContext) => boolean
  /**
   * When true, navigating to an earlier step does not call `canNavigateToStep`.
   * @default true
   */
  skipValidationForBackward?: boolean
  /** Called when navigation was blocked by `canNavigateToStep` returning false. */
  onNavigateBlocked?: (context: WizardNavigateContext) => void

  /**
   * When `false`, disables Next and the Complete action. When `undefined`, only
   * `canNavigateToStep` gates forward moves (and Complete stays enabled unless you set this).
   */
  // …
~~~

# 灵动岛 (Dynamic Island)

> iPhone 灵动岛组件,提供 14 种尺寸预设之间流畅的弹簧过渡,适合通知、播放器、通话等状态演示。

- 分类:特效
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/dynamic-island
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/dynamic-island
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/dynamic-island.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/dynamic-island
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import {
  DynamicIsland, DynamicContainer, DynamicTitle,
  useScheduledAnimations,
} from "@/components/ui/dynamic-island"

function Demo() {
  useScheduledAnimations([
    { size: "compact", delay: 1000 },
    { size: "large", delay: 2400 },
    { size: "tall", delay: 3800 },
  ])
  return (
    <DynamicContainer className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center">
      <DynamicTitle className="text-white">正在播放</DynamicTitle>
    </DynamicContainer>
  )
}

<DynamicIsland id="island-demo"><Demo /></DynamicIsland>
~~~

## 导出部件

- `DynamicContainer`
- `DynamicDescription`
- `DynamicDiv`
- `DynamicIsland`
- `DynamicIslandProvider`
- `DynamicIslandSizePresets`
- `DynamicTitle`
- `SIZE_PRESETS`
- `SizePresets`
- `damping`
- `stiffness`
- `useDynamicIslandSize`

## 依赖

- `motion`

## 源码属性定义

### DynamicIslandProviderProps

~~~ts
interface DynamicIslandProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode
  initialSize?: SizePresets
  initialAnimation?: Array<{ size: SizePresets; delay: number }>
}
~~~

### DynamicContainerProps

~~~ts
type DynamicContainerProps = {
  className?: string
  children?: React.ReactNode
}
~~~

## 备注

需要配合 DynamicContainer / DynamicTitle / DynamicDescription 使用;useScheduledAnimations 可按时间表自动轮播尺寸。

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | DynamicIsland 根节点必填的唯一标识。 |
| `size 预设` | `"compact" \| "medium" \| "large" \| "tall" \| "long" \| "ultra" \| "massive" 等 14 种` | — | 通过 useDynamicIslandSize().setSize() 或 useScheduledAnimations 切换。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

# 竖纹玻璃 (Fluted Glass)

> WebGL 竖纹(凹槽)玻璃图像着色器,来自 Paper Design,可调纹理形状、棱镜畸变、高光阴影等参数。

- 分类:特效
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/fluted-glass
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/fluted-glass
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/fluted-glass.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/fluted-glass
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { FlutedGlass } from "@/components/ui/fluted-glass"

<div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl">
  <FlutedGlass
    className="absolute inset-0 size-full"
    image={imageUrl}
    width={1280}
    height={720}
  />
</div>
~~~

## 导出部件

- `FlutedGlass`

## 依赖

- `@paper-design/shaders-react`
## 备注

需要浏览器支持 WebGL;所有视觉参数均可在运行时平滑过渡。

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `string` | — | 应用玻璃效果的图片地址。 |
| `width / height` | `number` | `1280 / 720` | 着色器画布尺寸。 |
| `shape` | `"lines" \| "linesIrregular" \| "wave" \| "zigzag" \| "pattern"` | `"lines"` | 纹理形状。 |
| `distortionShape` | `"prism" \| "lens" \| "contour" \| "cascade" \| "flat"` | `"prism"` | 畸变形状。 |
| `distortion` | `number` | `0.5` | 畸变强度。 |
| `angle` | `number` | `0` | 纹理角度(0–180°)。 |
| `fit` | `"cover" \| "contain" \| "none"` | `"cover"` | 图像填充方式。 |
| `edges` | `number` | `0.25` | 边缘柔化。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

---

# 3D 地球 (Globe (COBE))

> 基于 cobe 构建的交互式 3D WebGL 地球组件,支持拖拽旋转、明暗主题自适应、标记点与飞行弧线,适合营销页首屏与仪表盘。

- 分类:特效
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/globe
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/globe
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/globe.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/globe
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { DefaultShowcaseGlobe } from "@/components/ui/globe"

<DefaultShowcaseGlobe globeSize={520} title="CULT PRO" />
~~~

## 导出部件

- `DefaultShowcaseGlobe`
- `MarketingHeroGlobe`
- `ShowcaseConfig`
- `ShowcaseKey`
- `analyticsMarkers`
- `barMarkers`
- `cdnArcs`
- `cdnMarkers`
- `flightArcs`
- `flightMarkers`
- `getShowcaseArcs`
- `getShowcaseMarkers`

## 依赖

- `cobe`
- `motion`
- `next-themes`

## 源码属性定义

### ShowcaseConfig

~~~ts
export type ShowcaseConfig = {
  theta: number
  dark: number
  mapBrightness: number
  markerColor: [number, number, number]
  baseColor: [number, number, number]
  arcColor: [number, number, number]
  markerSize: number
  markerElevation: number
}
~~~

### DefaultShowcaseGlobeProps

~~~ts
export interface DefaultShowcaseGlobeProps {
  className?: string
  globeSize?: number
  title?: string
  orbitPhrase?: string
  /** When true, omit the centered scanline title (e.g. headline lives in the hero column). */
  hideCenterTitle?: boolean
}
~~~

## 备注

标记点与弧线标签使用 CSS 锚点定位。组件同时导出 DefaultShowcaseGlobe 与 MarketingHeroGlobe 两个变体,以及 CDN、航班、卫星、分析等多种示例数据配置。

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `className` | `string` | — | 附加到根元素的类名。 |
| `globeSize` | `number` | `520` | 地球渲染尺寸(px)。 |
| `title` | `string` | `"CULT PRO"` | 中心标题贴纸文字。 |
| `orbitPhrase` | `string` | `"Ship-ready sections · "` | 环绕轨道循环滚动的文字短语。 |
| `hideCenterTitle` | `boolean` | `false` | 隐藏中心标题。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

---

# LED 灯板 (Lightboard)

> 由灯点组成的滚动 LED 字幕板,含七段字体与手绘。

- 分类:特效
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/lightboard
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/lightboard
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/lightboard.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/lightboard
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { LightBoard } from "@/components/ui/lightboard"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <LightBoard />
  )
}
~~~

## 导出部件

- `LightBoard`
- `PatternCell`

## 依赖

- 无额外依赖

## 源码属性定义

### LightBoardProps

~~~ts
interface LightBoardProps {
  gap?: number
  rows?: number
  lightSize?: number
  updateInterval?: number
  text: string
  font?: "default" | "7segment"
  colors?: Partial<LightBoardColors>
  disableDrawing?: boolean
  controlledDrawState?: PatternCell
  onDrawStateChange?: (newState: PatternCell) => void
  controlledHoverState?: boolean
  onHoverStateChange?: (isHovered: boolean) => void
}
~~~

# 代码块 (Code Block)

> 带复制按钮与可切换标签页的代码块组件,内置轻量语法着色,适合文档与安装说明。

- 分类:工具
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/code-block
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/code-block
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/code-block.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/code-block
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { CodeBlock } from "@/components/ui/code-block"

<CodeBlock
  tabs={[
    { label: "npm", code: "npx shadcn add @cult-ui/globe" },
    { label: "bun", code: "bunx shadcn add @cult-ui/globe" },
  ]}
/>

// 或单段代码
<CodeBlock code="bun run dev" language="bash" />
~~~

## 导出部件

- `CodeBlock`

## 依赖

- `motion`
- `lucide-react`

## 源码属性定义

### CodeBlockProps

~~~ts
interface CodeBlockProps {
  tabs?: CodeTab[]
  code?: string
  language?: string
  className?: string
}
~~~

## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `CodeTab[]` | — | 标签页数组 {label, code, language?}。 |
| `code` | `string` | — | 单段代码内容(与 tabs 二选一)。 |
| `language` | `string` | `"bash"` | 默认语言。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

# 复制按钮 (Copy Button)

> 复制到剪贴板按钮,复制成功后图标切换为对勾并显示提示,提供 inline 与 overlay 两种布局。

- 分类:工具
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/copy-button
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/copy-button
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/copy-button.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/copy-button
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx
import { CopyButton } from "@/components/ui/copy-button"

<CopyButton value="npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/globe" tooltip="复制安装命令" />
~~~

## 导出部件

- `CopyButton`
- `copyToClipboardWithMeta`

## 依赖

- `lucide-react`
- `motion`
## 属性(Props)

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | — | 要复制的文本。 |
| `layout` | `"inline" \| "overlay"` | `"inline"` | 布局模式。 |
| `tooltip` | `string` | — | 提示文字。 |
| `variant` | `Button variant` | `"ghost"` | 按钮样式变体。 |

---

由 Cult UI 中文站生成。组件版权归 Nolly Studio,遵循 MIT 许可证。

# 悬停视频播放器 (Hover Video Player)

> 悬停即播放的视频播放器,带懒加载、封面、画中画与触屏支持。

- 分类:展示区块
- 本站页面:https://cult-ui.ndjp.net/docs/components/hover-video-player
- 官方文档:https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/hover-video-player
- 源码位置:`src/components/ui/hover-video-player.tsx`

## 安装

~~~bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/hover-video-player
~~~

## 用法

~~~tsx

  return (
    <HoverVideoPaddingWrapper />
  )
}
~~~

## 导出部件

- `HoverVideoPaddingWrapper`
- `HoverVideoPlayer`
- `HoverVideoPlayerControls`
- `HoverVideoPlayerHoverOverlay`
- `HoverVideoPlayerLoadingOverlay`
- `HoverVideoPlayerPausedOverlay`
- `HoverVideoPlayerPiPButton`
- `HoverVideoPlayerPlayPauseButton`
- `HoverVideoPlayerProgressBar`
- `HoverVideoPlayerVolumeControl`

## 依赖

- `motion`
- `lucide-react`

## 源码属性定义

### HoverVideoPlayerProps

~~~ts
interface HoverVideoPlayerProps {
  videoSrc: string
  thumbnailSrc?: string
  hoverOverlay?: React.ReactNode
  pausedOverlay?: React.ReactNode
  loadingOverlay?: React.ReactNode
  playbackStartDelay?: number
  restartOnPaused?: boolean
  unloadVideoOnPaused?: boolean
  playbackRangeStart?: number
  playbackRangeEnd?: number
  muted?: boolean
  loop?: boolean
  preload?: "auto" | "metadata" | "none"
  className?: string
  style?: React.CSSProperties
  onHoverStart?: () => void
  onHoverEnd?: () => void
  enableControls?: boolean
  cropTop?: number
  cropBottom?: number
  isVimeo?: boolean
}
~~~

~~~ts
  videoId: string

  defaultExpanded?: boolean
  customThumbnail?: string

  // Container & Layout
  className?: string
  containerClassName?: string
  expandedClassName?: string

  // Thumbnail & Media

  thumbnailImageClassName?: string

  // Play Button
  playButtonClassName?: string
  playIconClassName?: string

  // Title

  // Controls
  controlsClassName?: string
  expandButtonClassName?: string

  // Backdrop
  backdropClassName?: string
  // …
~~~
